policies.description: Tests whether B0 'freshness' carries information orthogonal to the entry-extension neighbor trio. Freshness is encoded as a (time_since_pivot_weeks, setup_state_indicator) pair plus a freshness_status categorical, so the upstream detection filter is an explicit feature. Vol-regime banded coefficients and the entry-extension trio sit in the linear block as controls. A non-positive time_since_pivot weight or a within-band coefficient delta <0.01 AUC would falsify freshness as an independent mechanism (q004 substitution test).

Tests the q010 confounder hypothesis: whether slope_ratio (ma10_slope_5/ma20_slope_5) is an independent ruin precursor or an artifact of entry tightness and denominator instability. The threshold term gates slope_ratio computation on ma20_slope_5 > 0.01, and the interaction term between slope_ratio and ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct exposes whether slope_ratio adds information conditional on entry tightness. A near-zero or sign-reversing interaction weight would falsify slope_ratio as separable from the entry-extension trio (q010 confounder decomposition).

Tests the q001 capacity-abstention claim: whether the Top1-Top2 quality gap should govern 3-slot capital allocation. Uses top1_confidence selector with explicit gap threshold so a large gap permits abstention (cash) on slot 2/3, while the vol-momentum interaction term prevents abstention during benign low-vol regimes. A negative shadow-PnL of the policy versus a forced-3-slot baseline would falsify the abstention claim.

batch_rationale: Three non-redundant mechanisms test distinct falsifiable claims from the synthesis: (1) freshness_residual_orthogonal_test operationalizes the construct-laundering falsifier from q004 by including the entry-extension trio as explicit controls and treating the setup-state categorical as a first-class feature rather than a null column; (2) slope_ratio_entry_tightness_ruin_gate tests the q010 confounder decomposition by gating the ratio on denominator stability and adding an interaction with entry tightness so any non-additive contribution is exposed; (3) gap_gated_continuous_slot_sizing tests the q001 abstention economics by coupling a top1_confidence gap threshold to a vol-momentum interaction, so cash deployment is regime-conditional. Each policy answers a separate research question (feature orthogonality, ruin-signal independence, slot-allocation economics) and would yield an interpretable null if its underlying claim is false.
